purpose: Provide one coherent integration and durable synchronization boundary for the completed FT-002 implementation queue.
success_outcome: FT-002 evidence is complete and internally consistent, completed Foundation/FT-001 behavior regresses cleanly, and durable docs are ready for feature-level semantic review.
anti_goals: No new feature implementation hidden inside the gate.
No FT-003 or downstream feature closure.
No overclaiming unavailable PostgreSQL or cross-feature evidence.

stop_conditions: Any FT-002 prerequisite task is not done or its evidence contradicts a canonical spec.
Focused integration exposes a missing behavior that requires widening an earlier task or public contract.
PostgreSQL authority claims cannot be distinguished from SQLite/test-double evidence.
Docs sync would overclaim shared requirement or downstream feature completion.
Evidence contains secrets or auth material.
